Commentary.Commentary: Done and dusted with the final game of the group stage. On Friday, the Super Four stage begins. We will have a couple of matches starting at 1530 local (1130 GMT). In Dubai, India will be taking on Bangladesh while Pakistan will face Afghanistan in Abu Dhabi. Do join us for all the action. Cheers!

Man of the Match, Rashid Khan says he is happy to contribute in all the three departments - batting, bowling and fielding. Adds further that he wishes to continue with this good form. States that during their batting they were focusing on every delivery but their main focus was to take the innings till the end and then do their best to put up a big total. Also says that they are working hard on their fielding and adds that by putting in some extra effort and focus, they can improve even further every day in the fielding aspect. Mentions that he always looks to bowl as many dots as possible, build pressure on the batsmen and eventually it results in wickets. Ends by saying that the wickets in UAE seem to be changing with every match and hence, they just need to focus on their performance and concentrate on giving their 100 percent each time they walk onto the field.

Afghanistan captain, Asghar Afghan thanks the Almighty and says it was an important day and match for them. Adds further that Rashid Khan and all the other bowlers bowled really well and feels they won the match because of them. States that they lost early wickets while batting and also did not play very well in the middle overs. Mentions that they had a great ending where Rashid Khan played an outstanding knock to get them to an above-par total. Shares that they had thought that any score around 250 will be a competitive one as they have some really good bowlers to defend it. Ends by thanking the crowd for their support and requests them to come back again tomorrow to support them.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says that Afghanistan deserve to win as they completely outplayed them. Feels that they did not bowl well in the last 10 overs and gave away too many runs. Adds that their batting was not up to the mark. States further that the big match is coming up tomorrow and they are hopeful to put up a better show. Mentions that it is difficult to recover from such a huge defeat and playing back-to-back matches also does not help. Accepts that they have to fight harder against India if they want to win. Also says that they are facing some injury concerns as their star opener, Tamim Iqbal is out due to his injury while Mushfiqur Rahim and Mustafizur Rahman are struggling with niggles.

Full marks to Afghanistan for the way they bowled and fielded. They showed good energy and enthusiasm and always had the upper hand on Bangladesh. Aftab Alam and Gulbadin Naib were impressive with their seam bowling and then Mujeeb along with Rashid did the rest. Their spinners, in particular, were very accurate in their lines and applied immense pressure. The Afghans were so clinical that Bangladesh got their first boundary in the 15th over and managed just 5 boundaries overall. Never allowed any chance to the Men in Green to break free.

In reply, the Bangladesh innings never got going. In absence of Tamim Iqbal, their top order looked very ordinary and failed to tackle the Afghanistan bowlers. The star all-rounder, Shakib Al Hasan, tried hard and finished as the leading run-getter for his team but the continuous fall of wickets made Bangladesh's job really tough. Altogether, it was a flavourless batting show by the Bangla Tigers as they face a hefty defeat.

Earlier in the day, Afghanistan opted to bat but didn't get the desired beginning. Hashmatullah Shahidi and Mohammad Shahzad then steadied the innings with a half-century partnership. However, the innings faltered once that stand was broken and at one stage it appeared that Bangladesh will bundle them out under 200. It required a quickfire partnership between Gulbadin Naib and Rashid Khan to revive their hopes as the pair provided the much-needed impetus to the innings. They amassed 95 runs for the 8th wicket and completely stole the momentum from their opposition. A special mention for Rashid Khan's batting where he showed his extraordinary ability to hit big.

Another comprehensive win for Afghanistan! A neat and clean performance to outclass Bangladesh. The Afghans continue with their progress and have once again made a strong statement. They top their group which in itself is a big achievement and to be honest, the way they are playing at the moment, they can be considered as a title contender.

OUT! Mujeeb wraps it up. He comes back and takes one ball to finish this off. It is just too good for the No.11 batsman as he is totally bamboozled by this googly. Mujeeb lands this on a length just outside off. Rubel comes forward to block this out but the ball pitches and turns in to beat his bat. He is thudded on the pads, they appeal and the umpire agrees. Afghanistan have dominated this game as they have demolished the Tigers by 136 runs!
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes back into the attack.
Fires it very full on middle, Hossain keeps it out on the leg side.
Rubel Hossain is the last man in for Bangladesh.

OUT! Run out! Rashid can do nothing wrong on his birthday. Got runs, wickets and now a direct hit run out. Champion stuff! Flighted and full outside off, Mosaddek attempts for an inside out drive probably but fails to middle his shot properly. He ends up mistiming it towards mid off as Rashid gets across to stop the ball. The leggie initially fails to do so and seeing that the non-striker sets off for a run. He is sent back but before he can reach, Rashid sprints back, picks up the ball and scores a bull's eye at his end. Well short! You beauty, Rashid!. The champion player has just taught the Tigers an important cricketing lesson - Never run on a misfield, especially if the fielder is as quick, agile and accurate as RK.
Fourth dot as Hossain has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bit wide of off and a bit short, Hossain taps it into the point region. Three dots to start by Rashid.
Beaten! Hossain goes for the cut on this flatter delivery, but the ball zips through on landing and the batsman misses his cut.
Tossed up and very full on off, driven to mid-wicket.
Shortish on off, punched back to the bowler to end the over.
Straighter and quicker on middle, defended back.
Quicker one on middle, helped in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Mosaddek has looked the most comfortable in the middle. A full toss this time by Nabi, Hossain picks it up and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Powerplay 3 signalled! Now 5 fielders can be put outside the ring. Not sure Afghanistan would want to.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run to complete the over.
Brings out the slog sweep but gets a big fat top edge. It lands safely in the deep mid-wicket region for a run.

A googly around middle, not read by Mosaddek who is forward in defense. It misses the inside edge to hit him on the pads. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. The replays later on shows it to be clipping leg.
Quicker through the air around off, blocked from the crease.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Tossed up ball on middle, played towards square leg.
This time Hider tries playing at it with a straighter bat but it goes off the inside edge to square leg.
On middle and leg, helped off the pads but straight towards short fine leg.
Gets forward and blocks it back towards the bowler.
Wide! Fires one down the leg side. Hider fails to work it around.
Tries working it around but gets a soft leading edge towards short third man.
Flatter on off, defended off the back foot.
Quicker and fuller on middle, kept out on the leg side.
Mosaddek has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and flat outside off, Mosaddek tries to cut but misses.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Makes room for the cover drive but it takes the inside half of his bat and it goes rolling behind off his pads.
A googly, Mosaddek reads it and keeps it out carefully.
Yorker on off, defended on the leg side.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Beaten! Nabi is a smart bowler, he flights it a bit more than the previous one and keeps it outside off. Hossain comes forward to defend but is beaten as the ball lands and skids through straight without turning in and beats the bat.
Tossed up around off, Hossain defends it by getting behind the line of the ball.
A slower and fuller ball on off is driven down the ground for a single. Hider is off the mark in ODI cricket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Abu Hider, the debutant, is the new man in.

OUT! Great catch by Aftab Alam! A tossed up ball enticing the batsman to go after it. Mortaza skips down the track to attempt a big shot but mistimes it completely in the air towards deep mid-wicket. It's a skier and Alam does well to keep his eyes on the ball. He catches it before going down on the ground. Never easy to catch those coming down from a night sky. Well done.
Two wides. Fires this one down the leg side. Shahzad behind fumbles to concede an extra run.
A bit slower and straighter this, angling into the batsman. Hossain waits and then turns it into the square leg region to get a single and retain strike.

The batsman gets beaten again as he looks to punch it into the off side but the ball bounces a bit more than he expected and it goes past the outside edge through to the keeper. They appeal but to no avail. Shahzad thinks about reviewing but then decides against it.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up around off, driven through covers for a brace. Nice elegant drive that from Hossain.

FOUR! A bit loose this from Rashid, a rare, rare bad ball from the champion leg spinner. He fires it a bit short outside off. Mosaddek cuts it hard through point and finds the gap for the ball to race across the deep point boundary.
Starts with a flatter ball on off. Hossain keeps it out from within the crease.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker and shorter outside off, Mortaza wants to cut but misses.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Turning down the leg side after landing on middle, Mortaza fails to flick and is hit on the pads.
Spinning back in and beating the bat of Mortaza. He is struck on the pads but no harm done as it's going down.
Flighted and on off, driven through covers for a run.
A fantastic wicket maiden comes to an end as Rahmat keeps this full around off, Mortaza looks to push at it but gets beaten by the away spin. What a start for Shah!
A bit tossed up and around off, Mashrafe does well to come right forward to block it out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit shorter outside off, Mortaza watchfully taps it into the point region.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Mashrafe Mortaza, the Bangladesh skipper, is the new man in.

Drinks. Afghanistan all over Bangladesh as we enter the second drinks break of the innings. The champion spinners from this team, mainly Nabi and Rashid, have put the brakes on the scoring and the leggie has taken key wickets to put Bangladesh in a hole. Will the Tigers be able to fight out and make a contest out of this?

OUT! Strikes straightaway. What a bowling change! Shah starts off with a bit shorter and wide of off delivery. Hasan goes for the extravagant cut. He has to reach for it a bit and cannot control his shot much. Ends up slicing the ball straight to the man at point where Hashmatullah Shahidi makes no mistake. Afghanistan inching closer.
Rahmat Shah is the new bowler into the attack.
Full and on off, fired in, it's defended to covers.
Quicker and outside off, Mehidy throws his bat at it and gets a top edge. It lands in no man's land at mid off for a run.
Flatter and turning back in, defended back from the crease.
Reads the spin there and works it wide of backward square leg for a single. The fielder misses his shy at the keeper's end and there is an extra run on offer. The batsmen didn't realize though.
Gets forward to push against the spin but it takes the inside edge. The ball travels to deep mid-wicket and they cross.
Flatter and on off, punched from the crease to covers.
With two slips in place, Rashid bowls a flighted ball outside off, a leg spinner. Mahmudullah plays for the spin maybe but it skids off the surface to beat the outside edge.
Hossain has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
And Rashid bounces back immediately. Spinning away from around off, the batsman is unsure of his footwork. Stays back to play inside the line but is beaten.
FOUR! Rashid gives this some extra flight and bowls it too full outside off. Mosaddek makes room and drills his drive through covers for a cracking boundary.
Another googly, bowled in the flatter trajectory around off, Mosaddek leans forward in defense.
Loopy and full around off, turning back in, the batsman lunges and defends it back.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot to end a tidy over.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
A bit straighter this one and Hossain works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A faster one this on off, Hossain plays in line of the ball but gets beaten as it pitches and spins away, beating the batsman's poke.
A bit fuller on off this, Hasan waits for it to arrive near and then glides it very late into the third man region to get a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is the new bowler into the attack.
A flatter and quicker one around off, Hossain watchfully keeps it out off the front foot.
A fuller length ball on off is confidently driven to mid on by Mehidy to get off the mark. He looks a decent enough batsman and Bangladesh will need him to play out of his skin today.
Mehidy Hasan is the new batsman in the middle.

OUT! It was just a matter of time. Rashid Khan has done what Rashid Khan does best, take key wickets. This one is kept on a fuller length just around off. Mahmudullah comes forward to block it out but plays the wrong line. He actually plays inside the line of the ball as it beats the outside edge and crashes into the off pole. Mahmudullah cannot believe it as he looks behind to confirm but he has to return back. The Afghans are seen celebrating and Mr. Khan does the dab celebration which Mr. Pandya and Mr. Rahul are famous for. Big wicket this for Afghanistan and they will look to wrap this up soon now. Rashid Khan has now become the leading wicket-taker for Afghanistan in ODIs.
Beaten again! Similar delivery around off and Mahmudullah is beaten as he comes forward to defend it.
Beaten again. A bit faster and flatter outside off, plays in line of the ball but gets beaten as the ball spins away beating the bat.
Tossed up around off, Mahmudullah goes for the drive through covers but the ball lands and spins in a bit to take the inside half of the bat and the ball rolls into the mid-wicket region.
Fires one across the batsman, Hossain goes back to play at it but again finds the short third man fielder.
Loopy and on middle, defended back to the bowler.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, Mosaddek slices his drive towards short third man again, this time for a run.
Shortish and on off, Mosaddek cuts but finds the short third man fielder.
Flatter and around off, played down off the back foot to point for a single.
Short and cut through point for a run.

Interesting thoughts from Aakash Chopra and Zaheer Khan on air. The former says that he would like to make a bold statement - 'Afghanistan are probably only 2 tosses away from making it to the final of the Asia Cup. Why? Because in Abu Dhabi, the win percentage of teams chasing 250 or more in ODIs is a mere 15.' To this, Zak actually does not agree or disagree. He simply states that the Afghans have become such a good team that bat or bowl first, does not matter. To be honest though, Mr. Chopra has a point. You can see what is transpiring now. We would love to see what happens if they are forced to chase though. Meanwhile, Dean Jones informs us that the attendance tonight is around 18,000. The capacity is 21K. Talking about percentages, that is a whopping 86 percent.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On middle, worked on the leg side for a run.
Flatter again but this time he strays on his pads which allows Mahmudullah to turn it into the square leg region and cross over to the other end.
Quick but fractionally shorter in length, Mahmudullah goes back and punches this to covers.
A fuller and slower ball to end the over, Hossain flicks it to square leg but no run on offer there. A wonderful maiden over by Nabi.
Tossed up on off, kept out off the front foot.
Faster and flatter around off, Hossain goes back and defends with a straight bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Wicket-taking bowling from one end and a stump to stump economical bowling from the other. Keeps this in line of the stumps, Mosaddek blocks it out off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Mohammad Nabi comes back into the attack.
Another play and a miss outside off to end this probing over by the champion leggie.
Beaten! Not easy to line him up when it's turning at that pace. Mahmudullah looking to push at it gets beaten. Rashid Khan at it again.
Similar ball, quicker this time on off. Mahmudullah defends it back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

91 kph and it spins away too. This is tough to handle even for the best in the world. He keeps it on a full length outside off. Mahmudullah looking to play at it misses as the ball turns away and beats the outside edge.
Rashid starts his third over with a flatter delivery outside off. Mahmudullah cuts it to the fielder at point.

Shortish and outside off, Mahmudullah taps it down to third man and keeps strike with himself. We've reached the halfway mark and Bangladesh need 172 needed off 150 balls. Not a tough equation but they have only five wickets left.
A mishit! Naib pitches it up and gets it to move back in a shade. Mosaddek probably looks to play through the line but gets an inside edge. It goes towards square leg and they cross.
Full and angling in from around off, Hossain leans forward and presents a dead straight bat in defense.
On a length around middle, defended off the back foot.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Mosaddek closes the face of the bat and works it in front of square leg for a couple.
Short in length and around leg, Mahmudullah turns it off his hips to deep square leg for a run.

Beaten! Nothing new for Rashid as he has seen this plenty of times in his career. The batsman did not judge the line and the pace on that ball as he looks to push at this quicker delivery outside off. The little spin away on pitching beats the outside edge as Hossain survives the Rashid threat.
A bit flighted this on middle and off. Hossain comes forward to defend it into the off side.
Quicker and in line of the stumps. Hossain watchfully keeps it out.

OUT! Got 'em! Rashid Khan again. You just can't keep champions out of the game for long. Rashid has got the first wicket on his birthday and that too the big one of the Bangladesh star all-rounder, Shakib Al Hasan. The leggie lands this on the leg stump line, Shakib stays back footed as he looks to turn it to the leg side. But he is beaten as the ball straightens and hits him on the back leg. The Afghans go up in a loud appeal and the umpire obliges soon. No reviews left and Shakib has to go back to the hut. Replays show that it was out. Bangladesh in deep, deep trouble.
A bit slower this but outside off again, the right-hander taps this towards points with soft hands to steal a quick single and get off strike.
A very full ball on off is driven crisply by Mahmudullah but straight to the fielder at covers inside the ring.
A shorter and wider ball outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it to the point region for a single.
A fuller length ball on the middle stump line is played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Overcompensates and fires it on his pads. This right-hander is a good enough batsman to flick it into the square leg region to get another brace.

A classic square drive. Nice sound off the bat there as Mahmudullah plays a gorgeous drive on the up through the cover-point region. The fielder at sweeper cover does well to run across and keep it down to two.
Tighter this time, a bit shorter of a good length around off. It is kept out off the back foot.
A bit full and wide of off, Shakib drives it hard through covers to get just a single.
Gulbadin Naib returns in the attack. He has picked up a couple of wickets so far.
Quicker delivery, around off, Mahmudullah finally manages to put bat on ball as he defends it to the off side. Top first over by Rashid.

NOT OUT! The decision stays as it is. Another googly by Rashid has not been picked by Mahmudullah. He lunges to defend but misses to be hit on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal and then go for the DRS. The replays roll in and it shows that the impact is in line but it's clipping the leg stump. Review stays.

Review time. The batsman in question is Mahmudullah as he is rapped on the pads and is given not out. Afghanistan though think differently and go for the DRS option. 'T' has been signalled and it's time for the replays.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. Rashid dishes out a googly, landing around middle and spinning in. Mahmudullah fails to defend off his front foot and is rapped on the pads. Too much angle on this one. Missing leg, maybe.
Turning away from the batsman, Shakib picks it and plays it off his back foot. He punches it towards sweeper cover and rotates the strike.
In an attempt to give extra flight, Rashid bowls a full toss on middle. Mahmudullah brings down a straight bat and hits it down to long on for one.

Flatter and shorter around leg, Shakib picks it off his pads and works it through square leg for a run. Every single is cheered by this crowd. Have to give it to them. The conditions are tough for them too but they are sticking around to support their teams.
Rashid Khan, the Afghanistan star, is introduced into the attack.

A bit risky this as Shakib goes aerial and lofts this over the mid off region. The mistimed shot works in his favor as the ball falls short of the long off fielder and they take a run to end the over.

The Shakib slog sweep this time, fine connection as well but it drops just before the rope at wide long on. The fielder rushes across to his left, overruns a bit but not by much. The ball stops a bit after coming down and it's an easy retrieval for him. Two taken by the batsmen.
Fires this quicker and fuller on his pads and Hasan flicks it through mid-wicket to pick up a brace. Scoreboard moving now.
A fuller length ball is driven softly into the covers and the pair run for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Long hop gets the treatment it deserved. Good batsman like Mahmudullah will not let these go by. Shenwari lands this very short in line with the stumps. Mahmudullah is quick to rock back and pull it over the mid-wicket region for a cracking boundary. They need some more of them.
A shorter and slower in the air, it is punched off the back foot by the batsman and he takes a single to retain strike.
Beaten! A bit slower this time around off from 'round the wicket. The ball lands and goes straight on to beat the outside edge as Mahmudullah plays for the inward spin which ain't there.
Again a flighted ball on the stumps is flicked into the square leg region.
A bit slower this around off, is tapped to point.
A shorter and quicker ball around middle and off is flicked wristily into the mid-wicket region.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Faster and flatter on the middle stump line to end the over. Shakib looking to pull it to the mid-wicket region is hurried into the shot and mistimes it straight towards the fielder inside the ring.
A fuller ball on middle, Mahmudullah looks to work it into the leg side but gets an inside edge which reflects to the off side.
Marginally short, or may be the batsman made good use of the crease to make it a bit short. He punches it down the ground and strolls to the other end.
The all-rounder shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A bit quicker and straighter on the stumps, kept out from within the crease.
A slower ball around off is flicked to mid-wicket.
Shenwari comes into the attack.
A well-flighted ball on off is defended off the front foot.
A bit short again and that much time is enough for Shakib to go back and punch it to long off to change strike again.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
A bit quicker and flatter in the air as Mahmudullah goes back and works it into the square leg region to go to the end end.
Tossed up around off, keeps it slow, Mahmudullah waits for it and blocks it out off the front foot.
A shortish delivery outside off is punched into the cover region to start the over with a single.

Aftab Alam is seen waking off the field. Struggling with cramps probably. These are unforgiving conditions. Just a reminder, these two teams will be in action tomorrow as well, albeit against different opponents. All the best. Fitness will be tested big time.
A bit shorter of good length around off is tapped towards the point region. No chance of a run there.
Rib-tickler handled well by the right-hander. He sees the short ball and quickly ducks under it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit short and wide of off, Mahmudullah looks to hit it too hard may be as he goes for the cut and gets an inside edge. The ball go into the ground beside the pitch.
Dishes this a bit shorter in length and into the body of the batsman, looking to cramp him for room. The southpaw pulls this into the square leg region to change strike.
Alam, back for his second spell, keeps it on a good length around off. Shakib defends off the back foot.

Drinks. So, Afghanistan are all over Bangladesh as they have snapped four of their top order batters and will now look to run through their line-up as soon as possible. Bangladesh will hope for a strong and long partnership to take them near the target. An intense phase of cricket on offer now.

Nabi flights this a bit more and keeps it outside off. Mahmudullah, looking to play it on the back foot, completely misses the ball as he plays inside the line of that delivery. Good end to the over by the skillful offie. That's drinks.
Hasan gets nicely forward to the pitch and drives this elegantly through the mid off region to get one more single. Bangladesh need to build a steady partnership now.
A bit slow and shorter in length, Shakib has punched this to covers.
Nabi keeps this on the middle stump line, the right-hander gets across the line to work it into the square leg region to pick up another run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tossed up around middle and off angling in from around the wicket. Hasan taps it into the point region off the back foot to get a single.
Way outside off this to entice Mahmudullah to go after it.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Fuller on the stumps is driven through to mid on for a quick single.
A bit straighter on his pads this one and the batsman has flicked it. The batsmen have run through for a single as the ball travels to deep mid-wicket.

FOUR! Edges win matches! As they say - In cricket, it's not how but how much that matters. Naib keeps it full and around off. Mahmudullah comes forward to have a feel of the ball and tries to push at it. The ball takes the outer edge and runs down fine of third man to go across the ropes.
Mahmudullah is the new batsman in the middle.

OUT! Dragged on and the sound of timber! Big wicket this as Mithun is a very solid batsman and Bangladesh needed him to be out there to chase this target down. But the right-hander has disappointed. Naib keeps this on a good length just around off and it's shaping in nicely into the batsman. The line and the length on this delivery are not ideal for the cut shot to be executed but that's exactly the mistake that Mithun has committed. He tries to cut it but gets cramped as the ball lands and moves back in a bit. It takes the inside edge before crashing into the timber behind. Bangladesh struggling big time.
Shortish on middle, staying low, Shakib helps it across the line but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Width on offer outside off, forced to sweeper cover for one.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mithun tries to play the reverse sweep but misses. Not sure that's needed at this moment.
Straighter in line, worked on the leg side but straight to square leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, driven through extra cover for a single.
A bit wide and shorter of good length, Hasan cuts hard but mistimes it a bit to towards the point region. A single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A slower and fuller ball around off is driven nicely to covers for a single.
Full ball on off is been driven superbly through the covers.

OUT! Fantastic use of the technology from Afghanistan. The onfield decision is overturned. Naib fires this a bit short of a length angling in from around the wicket. Mominul has a swing at it but the angle takes it down the leg side and it seems that the ball has kissed a faint edge of the bat. Shahzad pouches it behind and the bowler is up in a vociferous appeal. Nothing from the umpire but Naib convinces his skipper to take the DRS. He is very sure. Right then, the Snicko detects some wood as the ball goes past the bat. The Afghans are delighted as Bangladesh lose their third and are deeper in trouble now. Mohammad Mithun is the next batsman in.
A good length ball around off angling in, Haque tries to turn it into the on side, gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman to end a tidy over.
Slower and shorter outside off again. Haque rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to take another run.
A bit shorter in length and it gives time for the all-rounder to rock back and punch it in the gap at covers for the first single of the over.
Flighted delivery around middle and off, Shakib shows patience as he comes forward to block it out safely.
Slower and straighter from Nabi, Shakib flicks it away with a wristy shot.
On the money from the very first ball. Tosses it up around off. Hasan looks to push at it but gets beaten by the away turn. Good start by Nabi.
Mohammad Nabi, the experienced offie, comes into the attack.
Angles in a very full ball on middle, Shakib leans across a bit and flicks it fine down the leg side for one.
Another square cut attempted by Shakib but he fails to middle his shot.
Short and wide outside off, Shakib tries to cut but misses. Some extra lift there to beat the bat.
Pleasing to the eyes. Full and outside off, Shakib drives it through covers and returns for the second run.

Well stopped by the skipper! Naib once again is on the shorter side outside off, Mominul rocks back and hammers his pull shot through mid-wicket. Afghan gives it the chase and does exceedingly well to pull it back before the rope. Saves a run for his team.
Shortish and around off, Mominul mistimes his pull shot. Gets an inside edge and it hits him on the pads.
Powerplay 2 time! Afghanistan can now have a cushion of two extra fielders in the outfield. A total of 4 fielders now allowed outside the 30-yard circle until the 40th over.

Too full and on middle, Shakib nudges it off his pads but finds short fine leg. Done with the first 10 overs and not a single boundary has been hit by Bangladesh. Afghanistan have tightened the nozzle very early.
Mujeeb fires it in again, too straight in line and it has been eased through mid-wicket for a run. Rashid once again is super quick in the field.
Shakib has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total. The umpire is keeping a close eye on his landing and it seems that the spinner has been warned.
Quicker to Shakib, full and on middle, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Loopy and full around off, Mominul strides forward and pushes it past the bowler to long off for a single.
Flatter and on middle, punched off the back foot through covers for a run.
A length ball on off, Shakib strokes it down the ground. It's wide of mid off and they cross for a run.
Another delightful drive from Shakib but this time he finds the cover fielder.
Another sublime cover drive. He pierces the gap as two fielders run after the ball. The batsmen take a couple.
Pitches it up and around off, it's driven off the front foot to covers.
Edgy! A touch short and wide outside off, Mominul flashes at it and edges it down to third man for a run. This is not his natural way to bat. He is known to graft his innings solidly.
Wrong line first up, on middle and leg, Shakib turns it behind square leg for a single.
Gulbadin Naib to bowl. A slip in place.
Darts it in around off, skidding in, Mominul plays at it late and chops it out towards point.
A long hop on off, Mominul works it on the leg side but fails to pick the gap.
Shortish and on off, punched to sweeper cover for a run.
Flatter through the air again, on middle, worked off the pads but straight to short fine leg.
Straighter in line, a bit short too, Mominul gets the chance to go back and work it in the gap at square leg. A single taken.
A flatter ball on middle, defended safely towards mid on.
Aftab Alam is going off the field. Probably is done with his first spell.
A full toss, Shakib fails to put it away. He tries to but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Just one off the over. Afghanistan creating immense pressure in the early overs.
Lands it full and around off, Shakib pushes it off his front foot to mid off.
A single after 16 dot balls. Not in a very convincing way though. Mominul swings his bat across the line and gets an inside edge past the stumps to fine leg for one.
Targets the stumps with a good length delivery, Mominul blocks from the back foot. Plenty of dot balls on offer.
Once again the bowler keeps his length on the shorter side, Haque walks forward a bit and pushes it to the off side.
Short and around off, Mominul stays back and defends it down.

Probably a carrom ball, Shakib tries to push at it away from his body but gets an inside edge. It goes quickly and low towards Shahzad who fails to grab it. The ball further gets deflected off his pads towards first slip. Two maidens in a row. Pressure building.
Quicker and flatter on middle, defended again towards mid on. This is tidy stuff from the mystery spinner.
Skidding down the leg side, Shakib helps it off his pads to short fine leg.
Once again Shakib plays it with the spin but finds the cover fielder.
Gets on the front foot and drives it with the spin to covers.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked on the leg side.
Good length ball on middle, Mominul blocks it solidly to mid on. End of a wicket maiden!
Mominul Haque is in next with Bangladesh in an early spot of bother.

OUT! Told you, that's plumb in front. This is extraordinary bowling by Aftab Alam. He kept on bowling those inswingers to trouble Liton and eventually gets him out. He dishes out a length ball around off and it jags back in sharply to beat Das' attempted flick shot (his bat-face was closed and he was falling across). He is rapped on the pads, they go up in a huge appeal and the umpire wastes no time in lifting his finger. Liton walks up to Shakib and has a long chat (under 15 seconds) and then takes the DRS. The replays roll in and they show three reds. Liton returns and takes the only review with him.
Liton Das is given out lbw. That looks dead to the naked eye. Das walks up to Shakib and then goes for the DRS after an extended chat (flirting with those 15 seconds). Let's see...

Another length ball nipping back into the batsman from around off. Liton once again stays back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It ricochets towards point and he looks for a run but his partner ain't interested.
Good length ball landing around off and shaping back in, Das keeps his weight on the back leg and blocks it safely.
Pitches it up and outside off, moving back in a shade, Das drives but finds the cover fielder this time.
A length ball angling down the leg side, Das flicks it off his pads but straight to mid-wicket.
Loopy full ball on middle, it's kept out to mid-wicket to end a successful over for the Afghans.

Edgy beginning for Shakib! Mujeeb greets him with a short delivery outside off and Bangladesh's star all-rounder throws his bat at it. It takes the outside edge and runs down to third man for a couple of runs.
Shakib Al Hasan is the new batsman.

OUT! Another googly has outfoxed the batsman. Mujeeb drops it on a fuller length around middle and off, Nazmul runs down the track and tries to heave it over the leg side. But the ball turns away to gather the top edge. It balloons in the air and Aftab Alam makes no mistake at backward point. Mujeeb draws first blood as he normally does. Great bowling by him. 241 needed off 278 balls.
A googly around off, Nazmul fails to pick it and tries to work it across the line. As a result, it goes off the leading half of his blade to mid off.

Mujeeb slows this one in the air and lands it full around off. It breaks back into the right-hander who is forward to defend. But it takes the inner half of his bat and rolls wide of short mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted and on middle, worked off the pads but straight towards backward square leg.
A slower one probably. On a length around off and angling away from the southpaw. Hossain stays back footed and keeps it out on the off side.
An overpitched delivery wide outside off, it's driven through covers and Rashid gives the chase from the ring. He pulls it back before the fence and saves two runs for his side.
A length ball on middle, played down off the pads to mid-wicket.
Short in length and outside off, a hint of inward shape, Liton stays back to run it down to third man for one.

Once again Rashid in action. He's really electric in the field. Das flicks a length ball on the leg side but fails to beat Rashid at mid-wicket. He dives to take the pace off the ball and then recovers quickly to pick it up. No chance for a run.
Width on offer outside off, Das reaches out for it and steers it past backward point for a couple of runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Played out the first over by Mujeeb safely.
Full and on middle, this time it's clipped away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has driven it back to the bowler.
Flighted and on middle, flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.

Flatter and shorter wide outside off, Hossain slaps it from the back foot through cover-point. Shenwari gives the chase and slides to stop the ball. He parries it behind to the fielder who was also chasing and he returns the ball in play. Three added to the total.
Starts with a delivery on middle and leg, it's been flicked behind square leg for a single.
As expected, Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl with the second new ball.
A touch short and around middle, moving away, Hossain stays back and defends it towards point. End of a good first over by Alam.
This one comes back into the batsman but the line is too straight. Nazmul tickles it through square leg and gets off the mark in ODI cricket with a brace.
Beaten! Short in length and wide outside off, Nazmul tries to cut but misses.

Good stop by Rashid. This boy can do everything related to cricket. Can bat, can bowl and surely can dive around in the field. Alam once again with an outswinger outside off, Hossain punches it towards cover-point where Khan dives to stop the ball.
Another delivery outside off, this time Hossain allows it through to the keeper.
Big movement. The ball really swings under light here. Alam serves it on a good length around off and it further nips away after landing. Hossain flashes at it and misses.

Nearly a run out first ball! What a start to this run-chase. A gentle loosener by Alam first up. He sprays this one down the leg side, Liton can't flick and Shahzad is quite lazy to get to the ball. It rolls down to fine leg and they cross. The batsmen eye the second run but Liton decides to send his partner back. Hossain dives in at the striker's end. The replays later on shows that had the fielder (not the keeper) who has come up to the stumps gathered the throw cleanly, it would have been curtains for Nazmul.

Back for the chase! The Afghanistan players are in a huddle near the boundary line. After a thundering partnership towards the end of the first innings, they surely have the momentum currently on their side. Let's see how they begin with the ball. Liton Das and Nazmul Hossain are the openers for Bangladesh. Aftab Alam to begin proceedings with the first new ball. A wide slip in place.
